content.comment_body: Hello, I am looking to create a program that will send analog input data to an analog output until a specific limit I set. When the input reaches this limit, I want the input to be amplified before sending it to the analog output. Could someone advise how I can achieve this?

You can use an analog threshold trigger to check the value. The digital output from this trigger can enable or disable the amplification, allowing you to forward either the original or amplified value to the analog output using mathematical operations.
